title: Owner view: order with live state, waiting on the owner, blocked and nothing to do
goal: One page tells the owner what is next, what waits on them and which projects are stuck
acceptance: Solution order section: each item's status, priority, remaining and state (Ready, Waiting on X, Owner, Blocked, Not in backlog), first Ready item marked; `repo:STEP-ID` prerequisites resolved at the dashboard's resolved commits
Waiting for the owner, Blocked (root cause: owner step, prerequisite here or in another project, unknown, cycle, external) and Nothing to do (with the reason) tables
A summary per project at the top with an optional manifest `emoji`; open steps per component collapsed; fixtures: a ready item behind a waiting one, an order item for a closed record
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: The view never changes a source or orders work against an owner decision

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 for 10.16.0; review, CI and tag remain.
